title: Validity of encoded row bits
statement: For any finite Turing machine $M$, natural numbers $n,s$, and codec row $r$, its Boolean encoding has exactly one true input-head coordinate and exactly one true state coordinate. For each work tape, exactly one head-position coordinate is true; at each work-tape cell the two symbol coordinates are not both true; and the two output-summary coordinates are not both true.
